['MLP SE '].company_description: MLP SE is a Germany-based holding company engaged in the investment management and fund operators industries. Through its subsidiaries, the Company operates as a financial services company which offers financial products and solutions. The Company operates four business segments.

['Zech Group GmbH '].company_description: Zech Group GmbH is a global conglomerate with more than 300 companies and over 12,000 employees, operating in the construction and real estate business, hotel industry, and various industrial sectors. The group is headquartered in Bremen, Germany, and is involved in diverse activities such as cybersecurity, intelligence applications, and employee training through its central service provider, Zech Management GmbH.
